description: Start here: check a public URL before buying cited extraction. Returns fetchability, provenance, hashes, deterministic injection indicators and a free preview of the first 1,000 or so characters of text (short pages come back whole); not a safety guarantee. No payment or purchase. Example: {"url":"https://example.com/","maxChars":30000}.

maxChars.description: Maximum normalized characters to extract. Free preflight returns metadata plus a preview of about the first 1,000 characters.

url.description: Public HTTP(S) document URL. No credentials, private networks, authenticated pages or browser rendering.

name: proof_fetch_preflight
